findings.problem: Extra-arg append slices tokens[highest..] where highest is the highest REFERENCED index; a template referencing a non-contiguous subset (e.g. only &2) silently drops lower unreferenced tokens, contradicting 14.5's 'no supplied token silently discarded'.
findings.fix: Add a one-line caveat to 14.5 and the design algorithm naming this as a recorded limitation, or change the append rule to cover any token not consumed by a &N.

findings.problem: activate_menu_option calls rewrite_verb_to_root(option.command) unconditionally; a menu option whose stored command IS a template alias surface expands with an empty arg list on click. This consequence is never named, so it has no criterion.
findings.fix: Add a sentence to Req 19.6 / the menu-composition section stating the empty-substitution outcome (per 14.4) for a menu option storing a template-alias surface, or state that menu options are not expected to store template-alias surfaces.

findings.problem: 14.3 is written as settled ('&*' = all remaining tokens) while gate-summary lists the '&*'-mixed-with-&N semantics as an open owner question; a reviewer cannot tell whether 14.3 is final.
findings.fix: Mark 14.3 as '(proposed; owner to confirm &* semantics -- see gate-summary open decision 1)'. No algorithm change required.
